principle: One verified editorial source can produce platform-native variants; never blindly cross-post identical copy.

publishingSafety.browserAutomation: Use only where platform terms, account permissions, and a tested adapter allow it; otherwise use official API or manual handoff.

editorialProfile.opening: specific insight, tension, or business-relevant finding
editorialProfile.body: context, reasoning, evidence, implications; use short readable paragraphs
editorialProfile.cta: invite a professional perspective, discussion, or relevant next step
editorialProfile.linkPolicy: Use a descriptive link introduction; do not assume links are penalized.

editorialProfile.body: conversational explanation, useful detail, and local or community context when relevant
editorialProfile.cta: ask for a response, share, message, or visit when appropriate
editorialProfile.linkPolicy: Keep the post understandable without requiring a click.

publishing.accountConstraint: Page publishing; personal-profile publishing is not assumed.

editorialProfile.opening: short hook that complements the visual
editorialProfile.body: caption adds context rather than repeating text already embedded in the image or video
editorialProfile.cta: save, share, comment, visit profile, or use an eligible link surface
editorialProfile.hashtags: small, relevant set; never keyword stuffing
editorialProfile.linkPolicy: Do not assume ordinary feed captions provide clickable links.

publishing.accountConstraint: Professional account and eligible permissions required; Stories and other formats require capability-specific checks.

editorialProfile.opening: lead with the claim, update, or question
editorialProfile.body: one main idea per post; split complex explanations into a coherent thread
editorialProfile.cta: ask a focused question or point to a useful source
editorialProfile.hashtags: only when they improve discovery or context
editorialProfile.linkPolicy: Write a complete standalone post even when attaching a link.

publishing.accountConstraint: API access tier, rate limits, and media constraints must be checked.

editorialProfile.opening: observation, question, or clear point of view
editorialProfile.body: short connected thoughts; avoid press-release formatting
editorialProfile.cta: invite genuine replies and follow-up discussion
editorialProfile.hashtags: use sparingly and only where supported/useful
editorialProfile.linkPolicy: Give enough context for the post to stand alone.

publishing.accountConstraint: Account eligibility and API permissions must be checked.

editorialProfile.opening: spoken and visual hook in the opening seconds
editorialProfile.body: scene-by-scene script with on-screen text, narration, and shot guidance
editorialProfile.cta: one natural action, not a stack of promotional requests
editorialProfile.hashtags: topic-specific; trends only when genuinely relevant
editorialProfile.linkPolicy: Do not treat caption links as a guaranteed traffic path.

publishing.accountConstraint: Direct-post API access, app audit, scopes, and posting controls may be required.

editorialProfile.body: video outline or script with sections, examples, and retention-aware progression
editorialProfile.cta: subscribe or continue to a relevant resource when appropriate
editorialProfile.linkPolicy: Use description links with clear labels and context.

publishing.accountConstraint: OAuth scopes, quota, upload processing, and visibility state must be verified.

editorialProfile.body: keyword-aware description that explains what the destination offers
editorialProfile.hashtags: not a substitute for descriptive keywords
editorialProfile.linkPolicy: Attach and validate the destination URL where the format supports it.

selectionRules: Recommend only platforms relevant to the brand's audience, geography, objective, language, and available media.
Separate editorial suitability from technical publishability.
Show account and format eligibility before offering a publish action.
Do not list a platform as ready-to-publish until its adapter, authorization, and capability checks pass.
When direct publishing is unavailable, offer an export package or manual handoff instead of pretending to publish.
